response: This conviction of Father Bernard Domini, superior of the Missionary Family of Notre-Dame, in Paris under the new law targeting psychological subjection shows the kind of accountability long overdue against religious institutions that have wielded unchecked power to dominate vulnerable people. These hierarchies have for generations entrenched inequality, crushed resistance, and placed rigid control above basic rights, shielding exploitation while harming the most marginalized. Far from any attack on tradition, this is essential reform to dismantle those oppressive systems and defend communities from manipulation.
